title: Suneeta Pandey v. State of U.P. and 2 Others
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Manoj Kumar Gupta and Kshitij Shailendra, JJ.
disposition: Disposed; consider objection and pass final assessment under Supply Code.
headnote: Writ against a provisional assessment notice in an electricity-theft case disposed of with a direction that respondent No. 3 consider the objection dated 15 December 2023, though filed about a year after the notice, and pass the final assessment strictly in accordance with the procedure under the Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The Bench did not decide whether theft was made out or what sum was payable.
facts: Suneeta Pandey challenged a notice of provisional assessment dated 16 January 2023 issued by the electricity department in a case of theft of electricity. Counsel for the department informed the Division Bench that she had submitted her reply only on 15 December 2023, about one year after the notice, and that no final assessment order had yet been made. The respondents were the State of Uttar Pradesh and two others.

holding_units.holding: Respondent No. 3 must consider the objection dated 15.12.2023 to the provisional assessment notice of 16.01.2023 and pass the final assessment order strictly in accordance with the procedure prescribed under the Electricity Supply Code, 2005.
